title: Navigating Tensions: New Zealand's Naval Passage in the Taiwan Strait
description: The HMNZS Aotearoa, New Zealand's largest naval ship, made a rare transit through the contested Taiwan Strait, as confirmed by Defence Minister Judith Collins. The Chinese military tracked the vessel, highlighting ongoing tensions over the strategic waterway, which is claimed by China but recognized internationally as a major trade route.

title: Japan will pay 'painful price' if steps out of line over Taiwan, China military says
description: China's defense ministry said on Thursday that Japan will have to pay a "painful price" if it steps out of line over Taiwan, responding to Japanese plans to deploy missiles on an island some 100 km from Taiwan's coast. The remarks come amid the countries' worst diplomatic crisis in years,…

title: Japan: Trump telling PM Takaichi to not provoke China on Taiwan untrue
description: TOKYO — Tokyo denied on Thursday a Wall Street Journal (WSJ) report that said United States President Donald Trump had advised Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi not to provoke China over Taiwan’s sovereignty.

title: Japan denies report Trump told PM Takaichi not to provoke China on Taiwan
description: Takaichi’s suggestion earlier this month that Tokyo could intervene militarily if Taiwan is attacked enrages Beijing.

title: China Seeks Positive EU Policies Through French Dialogue
description: China urges France to promote EU's adoption of constructive policies towards China, as communicated by Foreign Minister Wang Yi to Emmanuel Bonne. They discussed issues including Taiwan, EU-China trade, and Ukraine. French President Emmanuel Macron is scheduled to visit China and meet President Xi Jinping next week.

title: Trump ‘urged Japanese PM not to provoke China over Taiwan’
description: The US president is reported to have cautioned Sanae Takaichi against antagonising President Xi during a call on Monday, though Japan has denied the claim

title: Taiwan Minister: Talks Held With US on Extra Defense Arms Buy
description: Taiwan Defence Minister Wellington Koo confirmed early coordination with the United States on weapons purchases under President Lai Ching-te’s $40 billion defense plan amid rising pressure from China.

title: Japan denies report that Trump told PM not to provoke China on Taiwan
